festivals.what: Karatsu Kunchi (Karatsu Shrine): every year on 2, 3 and 4 November; the evening float procession on the 2nd, the procession to the Nishinohama otabisho (resting place) on the 3rd and the town round on the 4th, with the hikiyama floats. There are no paid seats.

sources.title: 唐津くんち
sources.supports: 2 to 4 November, sequence, viewing rules (read directly 2026-11-05)

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: During Karatsu Kunchi the tourism association asks viewers to follow police and float crews, keep clear of the floats and their ropes, not walk beside or close behind them, stand back at corners, not sit on the road or step onto the route, and not use selfie sticks; drones are not allowed over the route or near the shrine.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Karatsu Shrine and the float-holding town groups.
